title: Correct time expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must derive or state the correct expression for flight time, t = (2v₀ tanθ)/g.

title: Correct time value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must calculate the numerical flight time as 3 seconds.

title: Correct distance expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must derive or state the correct expression for the distance s, such as s = (gt²)/(2 sinθ) or equivalent.

title: Correct distance value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must calculate the numerical distance s as 75 meters.

title: Kinematic equations setup
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly apply the horizontal (x = v₀t) and vertical (y = ½gt²) displacement equations for projectile motion.

title: Slope geometry relation
description: Important Criteria: The response must relate the vertical and horizontal displacements to the slope distance using the incline angle, such as y/x = tanθ or s = y/sinθ.

title: Trigonometric substitution
description: Optional Criteria: The response correctly substitutes the given values for sin37° and cos37° or uses tan37° = 0.6/0.8.

title: Units in final answer
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers for time and distance include the correct units (s and m).

title: Sign error in vertical motion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Using an incorrect sign for vertical acceleration (e.g., -g without proper coordinate setup) leading to a wrong equation.

title: Confusing slope distance
description: Pitfall Criteria: Mistaking the straight-line distance s for the horizontal range x or the vertical drop y.
